Yomoku offline word and name dictionaries

JMdict (Japanese and English components) and JMnedict (names) are compiled by
James William Breen and the Electronic Dictionary Research and Development
Group (EDRDG). Copyright in the source data remains with its owners.

These files are the property of the Electronic Dictionary Research and
Development Group, and are used in conformance with the Group's licence.

Source versions: daily XML snapshots created 2026-10-25. Exact source URLs,
SHA-256 checksums and entry counts are in sources.lock.json beside the index.

Yomoku transformations: English-only gloss/translation selection; XML entities
expanded to their human-readable labels; inherited JMdict part-of-speech labels
made explicit; ordered entries represented as JSON in an exact-form SQLite index.
Spelling, reading and sense restrictions are retained. The derived dictionary
index is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0, separately from Yomoku's MIT code.
No endorsement by EDRDG or its contributors is implied.

Licence statement: https://www.edrdg.org/edrdg/licence.html
Licence: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/
Full legal code: CC-BY-SA-4.0.txt (included locally)
JMdict: https://www.edrdg.org/wiki/JMdict-EDICT_Dictionary_Project.html
JMnedict: https://www.edrdg.org/enamdict/enamdict_doc.html

The complete EDRDG licence statement and project documentation are included
locally as edrdg-licence.html, jmdict-project.html and jmnedict.html.
